notes: Fresh Sep 7 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 122 judge candidates. Every candidate was reviewed for entity accuracy and all five B_V1 dimensions. Accidental ticker mappings, evergreen/commentary/prediction content, low-materiality general-interest stories, weak/noisy evidence and semantic duplicates were rejected. Eight strongest distinct events cleared the conservative final gate; fewer than 20 were kept rather than padding or wasting YouTube search quota.

events.event_title: UBS forecasts two US Fed rate hikes in 2026 after strong jobs report

evidence.title: UBS forecasts two US Fed rate hikes in 2026 after strong jobs report
Gold eases as strong US jobs data boosts Fed rate-hike bets

events.youtube_query: Fed rate hikes strong jobs report
events.judge_reason: The strong jobs report materially changed rate expectations, with UBS now forecasting two hikes; this directly affects yields and U.S. equity discount rates.
events.verification_note: Use the official jobs release and distinguish bank forecasts from actual Fed policy.

evidence.title: Canada’s Retaliatory Tariffs Set to Take Effect as Trump Threatens to Escalate
